slides.title:
5 safe AI habits.
Teach them **while
they still listen.**
The **boring** lessons that matter
items: AI runs on the grown-up's account. You see everything.
Never share full name, school, address or friends' photos.
AI can be wrong. Check before you believe it.
Spot a fake: ask who made it and why.
AI is a helper, not a homework machine.

slides.title: Why **early**?
slides.body: Kids are learning AI anyway, from friends and from YouTube. Get the safe habits in first, while the boring stuff still lands.
